passages.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?”
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David gave instructions to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster should use stringed instruments.
This psalm is a Maskil, which means it is a teaching or contemplative song.
The Ziphites went to Saul.
The Ziphites spoke to Saul.
They said, “David is hiding among us.”

passages.text: Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
He wanted it played with stringed instruments.
This happened when the Ziphites went to Saul.
The Ziphites said to Saul, “David is hiding among us.”
David prayed to God.
He said, “O God, save me by Your name.”
He said, “By Your power, defend me.”
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּב֣וֹא הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃ אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ תְדִינֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is in danger.
David prays to God.
David says, "God, hear my prayer."
David says, "Listen to the words I speak."
passages.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃

passages.text: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
passages.sermon:
Strangers attack me.
Ruthless men try to take my life.
These men do not care about God.
God helps me.
The Lord supports my soul.
passages.original: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
passages.sermon: God will bring evil back on my enemies.\r\nGod acts with faithfulness.\r\nGod will destroy those who oppose me.

passages.text: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David chooses to offer a sacrifice to God freely.
David says, “I will praise Your name, LORD.”
God’s name is good.
passages.original: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.
passages.sermon:
God delivered me from every trouble.
I faced many troubles.
God saved me each time.
I looked at my enemies.
I saw my enemies defeated.
God gave me victory over my foes.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מִכָּל־ צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
